$comment: Binding record for the archived raw npm audit report (RETURN-4 P2-6). The raw report in npm-audit-current.json is byte-for-byte as npm produced it; audit-gate.mjs hashes that file for the rawAuditSha256 ratification binding, so any future approval is bound to THIS evidence. Regenerate both files together whenever package-lock.json changes.
disposition: Three distinct advisories, all moderate and below the audit:gate high threshold; no waiver is on file and nothing is ratified. fast-uri (GHSA-hrr3-gc8f-f4qj) reaches the tree through secretlint: tooling only. uuid (GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq) reaches it through the prebuild config plugins: build chain only. decode-uri-component (GHSA-vcc3-ghjq-m6fr, denial of service by exponential decoding of malformed percent-encoded input; its one later release, 0.5.0, is not reachable within query-string 7's range) reaches it through query-string in expo-router's own runtime code, so it IS in the app bundle, and the earlier record's 'build chain only' for it is corrected here. As read in expo-router 57.0.19 on 2026-09-30: the router parses the query of a link opened from outside the app with the platform's URLSearchParams in its own fork of getStateFromPath and calls query-string only to write a query (stringify), so the affected decoding is not on the inbound path; the one call that decodes sits in the vendored react-navigation copy the router's linking configuration replaces. That reading is recorded as such, not as a test. Regenerated 2026-09-30 after a lockfile-only update of brace-expansion (1.1.18 to 1.1.21 and 5.0.9 to 5.0.12, four nodes, no manifest change): the gate began failing that day on two high advisories the database gained on 2026-09-28 and 29 (GHSA-qhr7-859c-m2p7, GHSA-6j4f-fj2g-mc7p) in that transitive tooling dependency, and the maintainers' releases of 2026-09-14 resolve both together with the moderate GHSA-q2hr-2g5m-vwhr.
